paite: Huchiin Jobin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: Ginlelh vuallouhin mite jaw na hi hi peuhmah ua, huan nou toh pilnaa si ding hi.
english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

paite: Himahleh noute bangmahin theihsiamna ka nei hi; nou sangin ka niamzo kei hi: ahi, hiaite bang thilte kuan a theikei a?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

paite: Kei jaw mi a inveng adia nuihzabuk ka hi a, kei, huai Pathian sama, hua aman amah dawnpa, mi dik, mi hoihkim, nuihzabuk kana hi.
english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

paite: Omnuama om ngaihtuahnaah vangsiatna muhsitna a oma; ahihhangin, a khe uh teute adingin mansain a om hi.
english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

paite: Suamhatmite puaninte a lohchinga, Pathian hehsakte akip ua; a khut uh pathiana neite Pathian in tampi a pia.
english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their God in their hands.

paite: Himahleh gamsate dongin, huan amau nang a honsinsak ding uh; huan huihkhuaa vasate, huchiin nang a honhilh ding uh:
english: “But ask the animals, now, and they shall teach you; the birds of the sky, and they shall tell you.

paite: Ahihkeileh lei kiangah thu genin, nang a honsinsak dinga; huan tuipia ngasaten na kiangah a phuang ding uhi.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach you. The fish of the sea shall declare to you.

paite: Hiaite tengteng ah, TOUPA khutin a hihkhin chih kua ahia theilou?
english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the hand of Yahweh has done this,

paite: Amah khut ah thil hing chiteng kha leh, mihing tengteng hatna a om hi.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

paite: Bilin thute a enchian kei maw, dangtungin a an achiam bangin?
english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

paite: Mi upate kiangah pilna a om, huan nite sauna ah theihsiamna a om hi.
english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

paite: Amah kiangah pilna leh hatna a om; aman thupha leh theihsiamna a nei.
english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

paite: Ngaiin, a kai puka, a kilam nawn theikei ding; mihing a khak binga, kuaman a hong theikei ding.
english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

paite: Ngaiin, tui a chinga a kang; a khahkhiaa lei a tum vek.
english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

paite: A kiangah hatna leh pilna a oma; khema omte leh khempa amaha ahi.
english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

paite: Thuhilhmite lohsamin a pi manga, huan vaihawmmite mihaiin a bawl hi.
english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

paite: Kumpipate kolte a suta, huan kawnggakin a kawng uh a gak hi.
english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

paite: Siampute lohsamin a pimanga, huan mi hatte a zou hi.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

paite: Muante thugen a suana, upate theihsiamna a la mang hi.
english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

paite: Lalte tungah muhsitna a buaka, mihatte kawnggak a phel hi.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

paite: Mial akipanin thil thukte a mukhiaa, huan sihna limliap khovakah a honla khia hi.
english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

paite: Namte a pungsaka, huan amau a hihsia: namte a theh-jaka, huan a lakhawm nawn hi.
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

paite: Leia mite hausate lungtang a la manga, huan gamdaia lampi omlouhna ah amau a vakvai sak hi.Vakna beiin khomial ah a mai ua, huan zukhammi bangin amau a hoisak hi.
english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

paite: Vakna beiin khomial ah a mai ua, huan zukhammi bangin amau a hoisak hi.
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
